name: SOP writing
short: Help writing a statement of purpose in your own words, for each university.

meta.title: SOP writing help for study abroad applications
meta.description: Write a statement of purpose that explains your study plan, your background and your goals in your own words. Wayfarer counsellors guide and review every draft.

h1: Your statement of purpose explains why this course, this university, and you.
intro: Admissions teams and visa officers read your SOP to understand your plan. We help you write it in your own words and check it against each university's instructions.
covers: A first conversation to find your story: background, interests and career plan
A structure that answers what the university asks
Reviews of each draft, with clear comments
Versions for each university on your shortlist
Letters of recommendation guidance for your referees
CV or resume formatting for applications
whoFor: Students applying for bachelor's, master's or MBA programmes
Students whose study gap or change of subject needs explaining

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: A counsellor asks about your studies, work, interests and goals.

steps.title: Draft
steps.text: You write a first draft using our outline. We never hand you a copied template.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: We check clarity, structure, word limits and each university's prompts.

steps.title: Finalise
steps.text: You approve the final version for each application.

sections.heading: Why the SOP must be your own
paragraphs: Universities and visa officers can spot copied or generic statements. Your SOP should describe your own reasons and plans. We guide and edit; you stay the author.

faq.q: How long should an SOP be?
faq.a: It depends on the university. Many ask for 500 to 1,000 words. Always follow the word limit on the application.

faq.q: Can I use the same SOP for every university?
faq.a: Keep the core story, but change the course and university details for each one. Generic SOPs are weaker.
